Most likely: GL system rounds down, bank rounds to nearest cent. Recommend: Adjust GL to match bank or set tolerance rule for $0.01-$0.99 differences.
Resolution_Notes: $0.01 difference remains. Recommend: Post small adjustment CR 0.01 to reconciling items or establish tolerance policy. Document for next month's rec.
